lead_raw_text:
The structure of V₂SiN crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—four V, two Si, and two N—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each N center coordinated by six V neighbors and each Si center by six N neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while V centers have six geometric neighbors (three N, three Si). The neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between V-centered 6-vertex coordination polyhedra, and edge-sharing between N-centered 6-vertex polyhedra.
